answer: A claim passes only when its owner proves the work live, interleaved. At dawn a falcon warden adds one micro-job from the ocean to the job; the claimant alternates both for one hour while an auditor checks each step against the sealed reference. A skipped step, copy, or silence is a broken weave: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. Five cents and an hour buy an honest pass; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and need 1,000 workers juggling two jobs at once.
